prompts.name: testing-tools
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a single wide 16:9 full-bleed supporting illustration for an educational video for teens. Hand-drawn black ink contours and muted watercolor/colored-pencil washes on cream notebook paper, sketchbook editorial style, subtle paper grain. A teen at a desk thoughtfully tests a laptop tool, checking its proposed bridge design against a small physical bridge model and a pencil sketch. One rough design visibly fails to connect two supports; a revised design connects them. The student circles the faulty connection on paper and checks the workable one. Teaching purpose: actively try tools, check where they make mistakes, keep what works. No claims about quantitative performance. Drawn stylized people allowed, absolutely no photographs or photorealism. Warm tan, blue, green and lavender. Clear readable composition, important objects within 8% safe edges. No typography, captions, logos, brand marks, numerals, border panels, cards or watermark. One coherent scene, not a course board.

prompts.name: think-first
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a single wide 16:9 full-bleed educational sketchbook illustration. Black ink contours with muted watercolor and colored-pencil washes on lightly textured cream paper. A teen student's hands, a pencil and an open notebook dominate the left foreground: original hand-drawn ideas for a small footbridge, including several alternative supports. A laptop on the right shows a refined version of the SAME bridge idea, with an alternative support arrangement. The original pencil idea clearly remains the starting point; student is thoughtfully comparing the two rather than copying an answer. Teaching purpose: form your own idea first, then use AI to sharpen it. Composition left-to-right, no arrows necessary; clear repeated recognizable design. Warm tan, lavender and blue palette. Stylized illustration only, no photos, photorealism, text, letters, numerals, logos, watermarks, panel borders, title or course-board styling. All key objects clear of 8% frame edges. One connected desk scene.

prompts.name: make-something
prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a single wide 16:9 full-bleed hand-drawn supporting illustration for an educational teen video. Sketchbook black ink, muted watercolor and colored pencil on cream notebook paper with subtle grain. A focused teen at a worktable assembles a small real footbridge model from craft sticks, beside their open sketchbook showing the same bridge. A smartphone lies face down, pushed away at the far side of the table. Hands actively fitting a cross-brace, model spanning two supports and all craft materials plausible. Teaching purpose: make something real and practice a skill rather than doomscrolling headlines. Optimistic but ordinary scene. Clear composition with the craft work central; important objects inside 8% safe edges. Warm tan wood, lavender, blue and green accents. Illustrated stylized person allowed. No photo/photorealism, no text, numbers, labels, logos, watermark, panel borders or course-board treatment.
